name: enable_object_control

stack.evidence: ScriptCommand_EnableObjectControl consumes one object ID, resolves it through func_001EAB00, queues object operation type 13 when found, and decrements Script stackTop by one

notes: The embedded operation-name table labels type 13 CONTROL_ON, and its dispatcher clears the object's control-disable flag 0x100000000. This is the singular-object counterpart of command 150 enable_all_object_control and the inverse of command 378 disable_object_control. The JP corpus contains 266 calls, including repeated sequences over object IDs stored in scenario variables.
